criteria.goal_candidate_metadata: PASS: StackManager adds formal_review metadata only for a Goal-bound reviewer assignment with a candidate; candidate and Goal ID come from the bound assignment/stack, and current_review validates the frozen candidate before binding.
criteria.formal_result_validation: PASS: Goal-bound result is parsed with the existing parse_object, must be one object naming the frozen candidate with an accepted verdict and nonempty string evidence; READY, NOT READY, NOT_READY, and UNVERIFIED are allowed Task results.
criteria.publication_order: PASS: sanitized handoff is validated before _run_job reports success; execute publishes an artifact and completes only after that success. JobFailed takes the Task failure path with no review artifact.
criteria.safe_retry: PASS: fixed failure text requests a new review Task in the same Goal for the same candidate and does not echo invalid result content. Reviewer binding does not mutate Goal state or advance coder generation.
criteria.generic_shapes: PASS: diff leaves non-Claude execution untouched; formal validation is a no-op when no formal_review contract is present. Added tests cover coder, candidate-less component reviewer, and legacy job freeform results.
criteria.negative_verdict_goal_acceptance: PASS by unchanged baseline dependency: autonomy/runner.py requires a completed reviewer Task plus candidate-bound READY evidence before Goal review acceptance; a completed NOT READY/UNVERIFIED Task alone is not Goal acceptance.
criteria.permissions_and_child_launch: PASS: the first-stage diff changes only the result validator/call and Goal-review metadata. Existing profile tools, permission mode, Claude argv/settings/background wait, environment, and child process lifecycle are unchanged.
criteria.task_store_and_scope: PASS: TaskStore and autonomy manager/test files are unchanged by this first-stage candidate; metadata is attached in the existing stack loader and validation in the existing job executor.

independent_runtime.journey: Actual A2A SDK Task handled by the first-stage candidate service/stacks; synthetic child process returned progress prose.
